en.introduction: I’m a developer working across data engineering, backend systems and applied AI. Turning complex problems into useful, reliable solutions.
biography: I’m Mateus, a developer based in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, and a Software Engineering student at Univates, with graduation expected in December 2028.

I enjoy working where software meets data: understanding a problem, connecting the pieces and making the result useful. My interests also extend to cloud infrastructure, open source and Earth observation.
Away from the keyboard, I like LEGO Architecture, games and learning how things fit together.

en.title: AirMood
en.subtitle: Earth observation, closer to people.
en.description: A voice-enabled assistant connecting air quality, weather and satellite data to everyday decisions.
en.problem: Make complex environmental data easier to access and interpret.
en.contribution: Developed the application end to end and led Tropa do Booleano. Integrated NASA Earthdata/TEMPO and weather data in a Python application with a voice interface.
en.detailContext: Hackathon project. Local winner in Lajeado and Global Nominee in 2025.

pt-BR.title: AirMood
pt-BR.subtitle: Observação da Terra, mais perto das pessoas.

pt-BR.problem: Tornar dados ambientais complexos mais acessíveis e fáceis de interpretar.
pt-BR.contribution: Desenvolvi a aplicação de ponta a ponta e liderei a Tropa do Booleano. Integrei NASA Earthdata/TEMPO e dados meteorológicos em uma aplicação Python com interface de voz.

en.title: WaterScript
en.subtitle: A broader picture of water quality.
en.description: A multimodal pipeline combining water samples, Landsat imagery and climate data for water-quality modeling.
en.problem: Predict water-quality parameters at locations outside the training regions.
en.contribution: Built data ingestion and geospatial features with Python and Snowpark, then explored XGBoost/Optuna modeling with location-based GroupKFold validation.
en.detailContext: Built for the EY AI & Data Challenge 2026, exploring geospatial data engineering and modeling.

pt-BR.title: WaterScript

pt-BR.badge: Projeto de dados e machine learning
pt-BR.description: Pipeline multimodal que combina amostras de água, imagens Landsat e dados climáticos para modelar qualidade da água.
pt-BR.problem: Prever parâmetros da qualidade da água em locais fora das regiões de treinamento.
pt-BR.contribution: Construí a ingestão e os atributos geoespaciais com Python e Snowpark e explorei modelos XGBoost/Optuna com validação GroupKFold por localização.
pt-BR.detailContext: Desenvolvido para o EY AI & Data Challenge 2026, explorando engenharia de dados geoespaciais e modelagem.
